note: RFC 2349: '#secs ... specified in ASCII. Valid values range between "1" and "255" seconds, inclusive.' TestRFC2349ServerDeclinesTimeoutOutOfRange: the bounds 1 and 255 are acknowledged beside tsize; 0, 256, abc, +3 and the empty value each draw an OACK with tsize 100 and no timeout (isolated: the OACK still exists, so the option alone was declined); declined 0 is not used as the interval (no resend within 2 s), and timeout 0 alone draws DATA 1 with no OACK. Off-by-one at either bound or accepting a signed or non-decimal value is red. Producer parseRRQ via optionInRange(TimeoutMin, TimeoutMax).
